      "observations": [
        "The original context-menu design raised target-selection, blank-space, local-folder and outgoing-server issues. It was replaced with parent Add button plus per-account Default/Delete controls; early right-click/tree-subclass proposals did not become the final architecture.",
        "All31 submitted inline bodies/proposals/statuses/anchors read.         "Tests now obtain defaultAccount/deleteAccount from contentFrame; none sentinel distinguishes absent default buttons on LocalFolders/SMTP from a disabled NNTP button. Removed isRemoveEnabled argument/call sites and confirmation-dialog helper are reconciled. Existing JSDoc boolean annotation does not fully describe the none sentinel; no missing-should-only historical finding.",
        "top.onRemoveAccount/top.onSetDefault dispatch to the outer window, avoiding importing AccountManager into each page and the reported ChatIcons const redeclaration. Final markup and actual receiver establish scope; linked MDN was not read.",
        "Default precedes Delete; Delete icon spacing and label Set as Default applied. DOM camel-case family and distinct Fluent value/label/accesskey families checked; current Add Account message differs from historical New Account label. No localization migration, keyboard, focus, RTL, contrast or screen-reader result was executed.",
        "Author reports successive bct5 failures and later Try pass. The reviewer identifies missing policy-menu initialization as a failure mechanism; author adds it in XHTML. This is historical reported evidence, not a new local test or blanket acceptance of all coverage."

      "observations": [
        "The actual nsIMsgTxn IDL extends nsITransaction and adds readonly msgWindow/txnType, despite recursive interface wording in commit/review summary. nsMsgTxn removes the generic property hash/interfaces; unrelated folder property-bag users gain explicit includes, not a global removal.",

        "Reviewer1216297 requests documentation delimiters for txnType. Author marks Done and final IDL uses a /** */ block. This records one API-comment generator contract; no generated documentation executed and no blanket delimiter rule.",
